attempts.text: Responsibility for manuscript conservation in Tiathban rests with the Kulgel Foundation, and has never been reassigned, reviewed or formally contested since the present arrangements were made. According to Gerfor Beortal, no decision has been taken on the loan programme, planned for 2046, and none is expected soon. Every register consulted gives 2045 as the year the Kulgel Foundation was founded, and no alternative date has ever been proposed in writing. Maintenance of the light unit was never delegated: it has stayed with Zundge through every reorganisation since. There are 86 sealed modules in the light unit, each sitting in its own fixed housing. The transfer of the Kulgel Foundation from Tiathban to Momdon was completed in 2049, after a full year of preparation and a further season of sorting the records. Whoever wrote the earliest history gave Baelles the credit, but every subsequent account names Zundge as the founder of the Kulgel Foundation. Any reading above 8 degrees Celsius puts the light unit out of service until conditions return to normal.
